overall_notes: Pair 4 (L4 + WS4) clears the bar on every category. ALIGNMENT 4: A9.4 and A9.5 directly drilled in minds_on, action stations, and worksheet; explicit cross-reference to L3 position words ('the cone is ABOVE the cylinder, BESIDE the cube') and forward to L5 capstone via shared manipulatives. PEDAGOGICAL_DEPTH 4: trap is the research-anchored no-target/Pre-composer misconception with named citations (Clements, Wilson & Sarama 2004 five-level composition trajectory; Clements & Sarama 2009 goal-direction; Mulligan & Mitchelmore 2009 AMPS), and recovery_moves branch by diagnostic — A (no target → target card), B (target named but wrong shape parts → explicit part-count to bridge Picture-maker → Shape-composer), C (one composition only → substitution challenge to Substitution-composer). INSTRUCTIONAL_BALANCE 4: 35-min K-appropriate duration; puppets explicitly OPTIONAL; differentiation includes a NO-PAPER, NO-PURCHASE PATH where children become the shapes (2 hold hands at right angles for square; 6 form hexagon; 4 stack as tower; 5 form pyramid) — the lesson runs on bodies + classroom space alone. CLARITY_VOICE 4: Sammy refrain 'NAME IT — count SIDES — count CORNERS! That's how Sammy hunts!' bookends both minds_on and consolidation with 3x clap chants; vocabulary child-friendly; success criteria all first-person 'I can'. MATHEMATICAL_AUTHENTICITY 4: composition trajectory is the explicit conceptual progression; substitution challenge invites children to compose the same target two ways (Substitution-composer level); research-grounded misconception names cited. LESSON_WORKSHEET_CONSISTENCY 4: WS04 Part 1 mirrors compose, Part 2 mirrors decompose, Part 3 captures 3D building; Part 2's introduction of a parallelogram is a justified transfer/generalisation task beyond the pattern-block targets practised in the lesson. Strict bar met: foundational four all 4, zero ≤3.
